scheme_name: Financial Assistance as Shagun in Marriage of Man Workers or Son of Workers - Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Applicant must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
Applicant must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
Monthly salary of the applicant must not exceed ₹25,000
Applicant must have at least three years of regular membership with the Board up to the marriage date
Application must be submitted within six months after the marriage date
Benefit is available for the marriage of up to two sons and for the self‑marriage of male workers only
Applicant must provide an undertaking confirming they have not previously availed the Shagun benefit
If the marriage registration certificate is not presented to the Board within six months, the amount received must be returned
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹21,000 is provided as Shagun for the marriage of eligible male workers and their sons.
documents_required: Undertaking confirming no prior benefit receipt
